config.schedule: 20-epoch cosine decay to 1% of initial learning rate; no early stopping
config.augmentation: uniform rotations by multiples of 90 degrees and horizontal flip with probability 0.5
config.precision: bfloat16 autocast with float32 loss; gradient norm checked for finiteness
config.loss: 0.5 samplewise Dice + 0.5 BCE; boundary variant adds 0.1 morphological boundary Dice
config.initialization: ImageNet encoder; SCSE in all follow-up variants. Residual x_RGB + tanh(gain)*projection([x_RGB,edge]), scalar gain initialized to zero. Gabor and Sobel residual variants have identical initial weights within each seed.
config.selection: highest complete native-grid validation mean Dice; no outlier exclusion or metric EMA
config.status: Exploratory follow-up designed after inspecting seed-0 initial-study results. Same split and budget. Not independent confirmation; no within-run test-based selection. No novelty or superiority claim is prespecified.
